svg.title: Mochaa (naichii) — magical girl software engineer
svg.desc: A pink pixel-art magical girl profile for Mochaa, also known as naichii and 1naichii, a versatile software engineer working on web development and workflow automation: a contract dialog, a transformation GIF, an animated C grimoire, the current arc, a battle log of past roles, a side quest (an open-source AI engineering starter), a technology arsenal, a GitHub soul gem status with 0 day current streak, 15 day longest streak and 1897 yearly contributions, and links to X and GitHub.
